# Use a cloud provider

## Summary

Deploy self-hosted n8n to a cloud provider, including DigitalOcean, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider.md

---

Deploy self-hosted n8n to a cloud provider, including DigitalOcean, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

## In this section

Self-host with Docker Compose:

* [DigitalOcean](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/deploy-to-digital-ocean): self-host n8n on a DigitalOcean droplet with a real domain and automatic HTTPS.
* [Heroku](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/deploy-to-heroku): self-host n8n on Heroku.
* [Hetzner Cloud](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/deploy-to-hetzner): self-host n8n on a Hetzner Cloud server.

Self-host with Google Cloud Run (with access to n8n workflow tools for Google Workspace, for example Gmail and Drive):

* [Google Cloud Run](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/deploy-to-google-cloud-run): self-host n8n on Google Cloud Run, a serverless container runtime.

Starting points for a Kubernetes setup:

* [AWS](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/deploy-to-aws): self-host n8n on Amazon Web Services with Postgres and Kubernetes.
* [AWS with Terraform](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/deploy-to-aws-with-terraform): deploy a production-grade, highly available n8n instance on AWS using the official Terraform module.
* [Azure](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/deploy-to-azure): self-host n8n on Azure with Postgres and Kubernetes.
* [Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/deploy-to-google-kubernetes): self-host n8n on Google Kubernetes Engine.
* [OpenShift Local (CRC)](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/deploy-to-openshift-local-crc): deploy n8n on a local OpenShift cluster for testing, without cloud costs.

Configuration guides to help you get started on other platforms:

* [Docker Compose](/deploy/host-n8n/install-options/use-a-cloud-provider/use-docker-compose): install and run n8n using Docker Compose.
